ambiguity_witness.limits: Host performance latency and opaque query IDs are excluded from diagnostic evidence equivalence; this is a finite replay proof, not constant-time security or universal ambiguity.
ambiguity_witness.proof_basis: Equal complete sanitized reachable record sets, incident semantics, and source metadata; deterministic queries are filters over these sets. All legal parameters including windows, status as-of, limits and metrics partition the same data. Invalid requests yield same policy response.

limits: Five authored cases in four groups; descriptive counts only.
No live model result; plain/candidate AI comparison pending approval and access.
Replay removes or restores captured observations; it does not measure JVM overhead or vendor billing.
Native sandbox verification is distinct from the required container isolation gate.
All sources share a synthetic clock; live clock domains and fault effects require Java capture.
